mkdir -p programs && cat > programs/task-40e2809a.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Identify each 4-connected monochromatic non-background object.
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or color == 2 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    q = (y+dy, x+dx)
                    if 0 <= q[0] < h and 0 <= q[1] < w and q not in seen and grid[q[0]][q[1]] == color:
                        seen.add(q)
                        stack.append(q)
            objects.append((color, cells))
    # Move objects toward the 2-colored edge (top or bottom) by one cell
    # per pass, allowing all currently unobstructed objects to advance.
    gravity = -1 if sum(grid[0]) == 2*w else 1
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 2:
                out[r][c] = 2
    positions = [set(cells) for _, cells in objects]
    changed = True
    while changed:
        changed = False
        order = range(len(objects))
        for i in order:
            cells = positions[i]
            dest = {(r+gravity,c) for r,c in cells}
            if all(0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w and (grid[r][c] != 2) and
                   not any((r,c) in positions[j] for j in range(len(objects)) if j != i)
                   for r,c in dest):
                positions[i] = dest
                changed = True
    for (color, _), cells in zip(objects, positions):
        for r,c in cells:
            out[r][c] = color
    return out
PY
